extraction.notes: Whole annex read (pages 1-27). Text-file page numbers equal the printed page numbers. Each step assessment is a table (step, baseline, deadline, beneficiary conclusion, Commission assessment, checks, double funding, clear conclusion); items from the Commission assessment column carry no table flag because it is running prose, items from the checks, double funding and conclusion rows carry the table flag. All four technology steps due in June 2025 were extracted: cybersecurity law and strategy (assessed achieved), Law on Electronic Communications (not achieved, grace period to 30 June 2026), electronic identification and trust services law (achieved), and legislation on archiving electronic documents (achieved). For each, the beneficiary's own conclusion is recorded as a reported_view finding so that it can be compared with the Commission's. The step text, baseline and deadline rows restate Annex I conditions (MKD-EU-2024-007) and are not extracted; the table conclusions 'Fully achieved.' restate the Commission's conclusion and are noted as 'also at page n'. EU-level background (Gigabit Infrastructure Act timetable, Commission delegated acts under the Digital Identity Regulation) and the double-funding conclusions are not extracted. No Chapter 2 material. Out of scope: preconditions and general conditions (pages 1-5), energy, State-Owned Enterprises, judiciary and asset recovery steps; the inspection risk-assessment software and database (page 15, back-office sector tool); the Register of Public Entities published online in Excel (page 19, publication online is incidental). Theme-doubtful: two items on the digitalisation of para-fiscal charges (page 16). Period covered not given in the register or annex; the companion decision MKD-EU-2025-010 states that the request covers conditions fulfilled until 30 June 2025, not used here. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/. MKD-EU-2025-011-0051 added from the stage 9 recheck. MKD-EU-2025-011-0052 added from the stage 9 recheck.
